title: Chapter 138 What To Do If There Are Not Enough Bricks For The City Wall?
content:
Chapter 138 What To Do If There Are Not Enough Bricks For The City Wall?

After eating and drinking, Wang Shuo asked Ayub about yesterday's situation, gave a few words about paying attention to safety, and then continued to build the city wall with Xiao Laoteng.

They were divided into two groups and worked together. Some were responsible for making city wall bricks and some were responsible for building the wall.

Wang Shuo took out all the construction acceleration scrolls. The speed of the masons simply took off, and they worked like a spinning top.

The consumption of mental power could not keep up, so Wang Shuo went directly to Zhao Bonde and exchanged some medicines to replenish his mental power. The masons worked like chicken blood.

In one morning, 20 kilns were fired.

In the past two days, refugees have continued to come to seek refuge, and the manpower has continued to increase.

In the afternoon, all the 50,000 city wall bricks purchased were laid on the city wall.

Wang Shuo's face was filled with joy when he saw the tall city wall.

Wang Shuo calculated that if the entire city wall was built, it would be estimated that 400,000 city wall bricks would be needed.

This made him worried. Even according to the current progress, there was still at least a shortfall of more than 250,000 yuan.

"Master Architect, our city wall bricks seem to be quite different!"

"Just a few more days to build it, and it will be there! This is a huge project. You have to be more patient."

"No, there will be a group of bandits attacking my village the day after tomorrow." Wang Shuo explained helplessly.

After hearing this, Xiao Laoteng frowned and pondered for a long time, but could not think of a good solution.

He shrugged, spread his hands and said, "Lord, I have sold all my bricks to you, and there is nothing I can do about it!"

"I'll think of another way!" Wang Shuo said weakly with a gloomy face.

After thinking for a while, his eyes lit up. Since he was buying bricks, it wasn't who he was buying.

He immediately returned to the council chamber and summoned Hadro.

"Lord, how long has it been but you have already missed me again!" After Hadro agreed to Wang Shuo's request, he immediately appeared in the magnificent meeting hall.

Hadro took one look at the spacious and luxurious hall and was shocked.

Wang Shuo said straight to the point: "Hadro, I am in urgent need of black iron city wall bricks. Is there any way you can get this?"

Hadro frowned and thought for a long time, as if thinking about whether he could get such a thing.

After a while, he asked softly: "Lord, how much do you need?"

"300,000 yuan." Wang Shuo is not afraid of more, but he is afraid that the quantity is not enough. When the time comes, a section of the city wall is missing and the defensive formation cannot be connected as a whole, which will be embarrassing.

"When do you want it?"

"The sooner the better, noon tomorrow at the latest."

"Let me think about it." After a while, he said to Wang Shuo: "Lord, the time is too short. Isn't this matter difficult to handle?"

"Huh, old fox, it's hard to handle, so I'll just have to pay more!" Wang Shuo thought in his heart.

"Tell me, what does it take to do it?" Wang Shuo could only let him control him at this time.

"Lord, it's like this. We have a lot of sellers who bake this kind of city bricks. I have to use the teleportation array to go to other places to buy them. And there are too many. I guess I have to go to many houses, or even just Acquired at a high price, so..."

He paused for a moment, then lowered his voice and said, "This price is higher than usual. Lord, can you accept it?"

"Tell me the number!"

"Eighty silver coins a piece." Hadro was a little worried, wondering if the price quoted was too high.

"What did you say?" Wang Shuo's expression changed, and his whole face became gloomy.
